'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jan Westergard DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jan Westergard]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' The Cats In Hats
* '''Username:''' GhostTrain
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
